choices.reason: No rule uniquely separates these candidates: all use the same primary model, creative-writing composite, session, and repeated task, with no designated primary contrast or participant-level SD/data_stats advantage. All AI arms use constrained, undisclosed personas without a uniquely supported closest free-chatbot configuration or a reported combined AI-versus-H3 estimate, and the factorial-design rule does not distinguish these contrasts.

choices.quote:
The prompts were designed to operationalise two distinct interaction styles, contrarian and supportive, while
maintaining high ecological validity by enforcing human-like language use, conversational variability, and strict non-
disclosure of artificial identity.
